err.llm.network: Network error towards the model; {reason} = short reason in English (e.g. truncated, fetch).
err.llm.proxy.body: The demo proxy rejects the request; {field} = rejected part in English (e.g. size, json, session).
err.llm.proxy.budget: Global budget of the demo exhausted; {limit} = period in English (day or month).
err.llm.limit.spend: Spending cap reached; {limit} = which cap in English (session, ip, rate, tokens).
err.llm.replay.mismatch: The request does not match the recording; {turn} = turn number.
err.llm.conversation: Invalid conversation; {field} = field that is missing or wrong.
err.llm.tools: Invalid tool catalog; {field} = field that is missing or wrong.
err.llm.inspection.invalid: CLI error of llm params: the file given to --inspection is not an inspection/1; {from} = its path or - for standard input.
err.llm.inspection.settled: CLI error of llm params: --budget or --hide-names given together with --inspection.
err.llm.inputs.twice: CLI error of llm inspect and llm params: the same file named twice; {path} = the path.
err.llm.eval.case: CLI error of llm eval: a case file that is not a llm-eval/1; {field} = the field that is missing or wrong, {file} = its path.
err.llm.eval.loop: CLI error of llm eval: the recording ends before the case is done; {case} = the case id.
